---
title: "Role Card: IT Lead (Meridian)"
---

**Your side:** Meridian Analytics
**Your role:** IT Lead

---

You have strong opinions about tools, and you have good reasons for them. Apex's ad-hoc Slack culture is not just chaotic — it's a security and compliance risk. Client data, decision trails, project documentation: all of it needs to live in systems your team controls and can audit.

You will raise this at some point. Probably more than once. You're not trying to be difficult; you genuinely believe that "we'll just use Slack" is a decision that sounds small and isn't.

---
